text: baseUrlFrom defaults the scheme to https when X-Forwarded-Proto is absent, so a plain-http instance (every local/dev server, this review's) renders /install and /skill.md with 'https://127.0.0.1:18806'; the literal first step `curl -X POST https://127.0.0.1:18806/api/enroll` fails (curl exit 35), the agent must guess http (second attempt #1). Fix: default to http unless config.baseUrl or an X-Forwarded-* header is present, and keep https for proxied deployments.
